blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in South Slope fell from 43 in June to 34 in September (−20.9%), and 18 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 7.4% of Burnaby’s 458 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in South Slope?
South Slope also had 40 condos and townhomes listed and 10 sold in September, against 34 houses listed. The South Slope condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in South Slope?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 34 houses listed in South Slope. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is South Slope a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in South Slope had a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in South Slope from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 18 houses sold in South Slope over those 4 months, out of 199 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in South Slope?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
